scenes.text: A *free* desktop AI that runs *offline*, so client files never leave your laptop

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: Oct 26: Hob 0.2, a free open-source app for Mac, Windows and Linux. It picks an open model that fits your machine, like Gemma or gpt-oss, and sets it up.
Fill out PDFs, work through documents. No internet needed.

scenes.title: The *money* use
lines: Bookkeepers, virtual assistants and paralegals with NDA files can finally use AI on them.
Try: drop in a client contract and ask for the payment terms and deadlines.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: Small local models are weaker than ChatGPT or Claude. Good for sorting and summarizing, not legal advice.
Needs a recent machine; older laptops crawl. Version 0.2 is early software. Source: Hob on GitHub, Oct 26, 2026.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: Free. MIT license, no account, no subscription.
The only cost is disk space for the model.
